title: LETTER 6: Letter to Bank Manager — Request to Waive Processing Fee

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Maintain a strictly professional, polite, and persuasive tone throughout the letter.
Always quote the reference numbers such as Loan Application ID, Account Number, or Sanction Letter reference.
Provide a valid justification for the waiver request, such as a long-standing banking relationship or impeccable credit history.
State the exact processing fee amount or percentage requested for waiver clearly in the body.
Follow standard formal letter conventions, including sender details, date, designation, subject line, salutation, and sign-off.

blocks.content: I request you to kindly consider waiving the processing fee as a special gesture, keeping in view my long-standing association and flawless credit track record with your bank.

rows: Mentions specific Loan Application ID and account relationship history.
Omits account details or reference numbers.
Politely requests waiver based on loyalty, clean credit score, or promotional context.
Demands fee reduction aggressively without justification.
Follows crisp formal layout with concise 3-paragraph structure.
Uses informal language or lengthy irrelevant narrative.

items: Ensure the subject line explicitly includes the core request alongside the loan application/account number.
Avoid aggressive or demanding tone; requests for fee waivers rely on goodwill and customer track record.
Descriptive exams award marks for correct layout structure: Sender Address, Date, Receiver Address, Subject, Salutation, Body, and Subscription.
